panels.assessment: Signed drift uses a zero line and positive/negative symlog ticks; species and EE sign changes are visible. It does not replace signed amplitude by a norm.
Same-energy EI/EE diffusion ratios use a log scale and distinguish each ion from the summed EI curve; the low-energy enhancement and high-energy mass suppression remain visible.
Integrated first-stop ion bath gain is labeled eV per selected electron, R=80; chi and N are explicit. It is not labeled instantaneous power or Maxwellization.
CE probability change and no-CE first-entry mean change have separate labeled percent axes. Title distinguishes circle and square markers, and chi/N legend remains readable.

scope_limits: The plot is a diagnostic for the selected equal-temperature frozen bath and finite chain.
First entry is not irreversible assimilation or Maxwellization.
CE internal energy is not relabeled final gas heat.
No global network completion or continuum error bound is stated.
